kpis.description_fr: Bitcoin détenus fin FY24. Plus grand corporate holder mondial. Stratégie 'Bitcoin Treasury Reserve' via émissions equity+convertibles.
kpis.description_en: Bitcoin held end FY24. Largest corporate holder globally. 'Bitcoin Treasury Reserve' strategy via equity+convertibles issuance.

kpis.description_fr: BTC Yield FY24 = % growth BTC/share. KPI propriétaire MSTR mesurant accroissement BTC per diluted share via émissions accrétives.
kpis.description_en: BTC Yield FY24 = BTC/share growth %. MSTR proprietary KPI measuring BTC per diluted share increase via accretive issuance.

kpis.description_fr: Coût moyen acquisition par BTC FY24. Hausse liée gros achats 2024 à prix élevés. Vs spot ~$95k, MTM gains.
kpis.description_en: Avg BTC acquisition cost FY24. Rise from 2024 high-price purchases. Vs ~$95k spot, MTM gains.

kpis.description_fr: Premium cours/NAV BTC (mNAV) fin FY24. Sustainability question : >2.5x = retail/leverage exuberance.
kpis.description_en: Stock price/BTC NAV premium (mNAV) end FY24. Sustainability question: >2.5x = retail/leverage exuberance.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu logiciel BI legacy FY24. Business core historique en déclin lent. Cashflow stable, finance partiellement achats BTC.
kpis.description_en: Legacy BI software revenue FY24. Slowly declining historical core business. Stable cashflow partly funds BTC purchases.

kpis_story.description_fr: Annonce Oct 2024 : plan '21/21' = $21Md equity + $21Md fixed income sur 3 ans pour accélérer BTC accumulation. Cible BTC yield 6-10%/an. Rebaptisé 'Strategy' Feb 2025.
kpis_story.description_en: Oct 2024 announcement: '21/21' plan = $21Bn equity + $21Bn fixed income over 3 years to accelerate BTC accumulation. 6-10%/year BTC yield target. Rebranded 'Strategy' Feb 2025.

_notes: Bitcoin treasury proxy. Source: 10-K FY24 filed Feb 2025.
